name: guests-api
description: REST API for managing couchsurfing guests

scripts.network:ensure:dev: docker network inspect cs_network_dev >NUL 2>&1 || docker network create --driver bridge cs_network_dev
scripts.network:ensure:prod: docker network inspect cs_network_prod >NUL 2>&1 || docker network create --driver bridge cs_network_prod
scripts.dev:docker: npm run network:ensure:dev && docker compose -p cs-dev -f docker-compose.dev.yml up --build
scripts.prod:docker: npm run network:ensure:prod && docker compose -p cs-prod -f docker-compose.yml up --build -d
scripts.seed:docker: docker compose -p cs-dev -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec cs_api npx ts-node src/scripts/seed.ts
scripts.seed:prod:docker: docker compose -p cs-prod -f docker-compose.yml exec cs_api node dist/scripts/seed.js
